chinese.before: 三篇文章，从一辆三次失去的车、虎妞与小福子的受限选择，到一个仍活着却发生了不止贫困之变化的人。
chinese.after: 三篇文章，从三次落空的希望——被夺走的车、被敲走的买车积蓄、为丧事卖掉的旧车——写到虎妞与小福子的受限选择，以及一个仍活着却发生了不止贫困之变化的人。

english.before: Three essays on one rickshaw lost three times, Huniu and Xiaofuzi’s constrained choices, and a living man whose deterioration is more than poverty.
english.after: Three essays on three defeated hopes: a seized rickshaw, extorted savings for another, and a used rickshaw sold for a funeral; on Huniu and Xiaofuzi’s constrained choices; and on a living man whose deterioration is more than poverty.
